categories.main_business_segments: Zhejiang Zheneng Electric Power Co., Ltd. primarily operates in power generation including coal-fired power, gas power, nuclear power, combined heat and power, and integrated energy services. The company also controls Suzhou Zhonglai Photovoltaic New Material Co., Ltd., which focuses on photovoltaic auxiliary materials, high-efficiency cells and modules, and photovoltaic applications.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes traditional thermal power generation technologies alongside advanced nuclear power technologies. In photovoltaic business, it employs high-efficiency photovoltaic cell technologies such as n-type TOPCon, heterojunction, and XBC cells. Manufacturing methods include large-scale power plant operations and photovoltaic module production with continuous R&D in energy efficiency and green energy technologies.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include provincial power grid companies such as State Grid Zhejiang Electric Power Co., Ltd., and other electricity purchasers. The company serves the Zhejiang province primarily, with some operations and sales extending to other domestic regions and limited foreign markets. The photovoltaic segment targets global markets with manufacturing and sales of photovoltaic products.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company’s main operations and controlled power plants are concentrated in Zhejiang Province, China. It also has investments and subsidiaries in other Chinese provinces and overseas, including photovoltaic manufacturing facilities and investments in Europe, India, and Southeast Asia.
categories.supply_chain_position: Zhejiang Zheneng Electric Power operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the energy supply chain, focusing on power generation and energy supply. Through its photovoltaic subsidiary, it also participates in upstream manufacturing of photovoltaic materials and components.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes high-quality energy supply and green low-carbon transformation, focusing on innovation in energy efficiency, renewable energy integration, and nuclear power development. R&D priorities include advanced photovoltaic technologies, energy storage, virtual power plants, and smart grid applications to enhance operational efficiency and sustainability.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through electricity and heat sales to grid companies and end-users, sales of photovoltaic products and systems, and investment income from equity holdings. The company also earns income from government subsidies, financial investments, and asset disposals.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: As the largest power generation enterprise in Zhejiang Province, the company holds a significant market share in thermal and nuclear power sectors. It competes with other provincial and national power companies, including China Huaneng Group and China General Nuclear Power Group, while positioning itself as a leading modern green energy enterprise with diversified energy assets.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported total operating revenue of approximately RMB 88 billion, with a net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 7.75 billion, reflecting an 18.92% year-on-year increase. Total assets reached RMB 154 billion, showing steady growth supported by increased power generation and strategic investments.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company offers reliable and diversified energy supply with a strong emphasis on green and low-carbon energy solutions. Its integration of traditional and renewable energy sources, advanced nuclear power investments, and photovoltaic technology leadership provide competitive differentiation. The company also highlights its robust governance, safety management, and commitment to sustainable development as key value propositions.
